question: Who among the following freedom fighters has been honoured with the title of 'The​ Iron Man Of India'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vallabhbhai Patel.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vallabhbhai Patel**

 
 
• ​Vallabhbhai Jhaverbhai Patel, more commonly referred to as **Sardar Patel**, was an **Indian lawyer, influential political leader, barrister, and statesman** who was the **first Deputy Prime Minister** and** Home Minister of India from 1947 to 1950**. He was born on October 31, 1875, and passed away on December 15, 1950.
